snippet.title: Wolfling teaser
snippet.description:
A teaser video of the upcoming game "Wolfling reloaded"!
(for Windows, Mac, Linux and C64)

It features a previously unseen hires variation of 4-charset-trick parallax scrolling, graphics from Zolionline and music from Cyborgjeff. The game is still under construction, stay tuned...
The teaser is available as C64 program for your C64 or emulator over here: http://www.lazycow.de/wolfling/wolflingteaser.zip
